title: Pharmacy continuous quality improvement program
rule_summary: Each pharmacy must maintain a continuous quality improvement program that detects, documents, assesses, and prevents quality-related events.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply cqi program requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.
exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing cqi program with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
